text:
Maya (People Ops): Heads-up 1Samir (new hire) is in transit and will arrive late-night Sun. He asked about same-day I-9 on Mon morning and hotel delivery for laptop. He mentioned passport expired but carries a Canadian PR card and Ontario driver's license.

Ethan (Recruiter): Samir is flexible: prefers hotel delivery but can come to office for 9:30am I-9 if we book interpreter (Hindi). He might be jet-lagged.

Samir (candidate): Confirming I can do 9:30am at HQ. Can you avoid asking for a signature at hotel check-in? Please label package for front desk guest pickup. Also I will upload scans tonight.

Lina (Onboarding): Canadian PR card = List A, so I-9 acceptable. Expired passport won't work. Two options: (A) In-person drop-in 9:30am with Hindi interpreter booked, or (B) NotaryNow remote session the evening before (must be physically in US during signing). Please upload front and back of PR card + DL to secure portal by EOD.

IT-bot: Hotel shipping OK if label precisely: 
"Hold for: Samir Patel / Redwood Inference - Guest Pickup"
Include mobile + check-in name. NOTE: asset held until AUP signed. We can drop to front desk for 24h hold.

BGCheck Team: Background vendor flagged international history; without SSN we can run identity-first checks but certain county searches might delay. Please have candidate sign consent now so we can kick off.

Maya (People Ops): Action items: 1) Ethan ask Samir to upload docs & sign BG consent, 2) Lina book Hindi interpreter and 9:30 drop-in slot, 3) IT label hotel hold-for and email AUP link, 4) If Samir cannot make 9:30, NotaryNow link and instructions in calendar invite.

Ethan (Recruiter): Sent candidate message: "Upload PR card + DL to secure portal; sign BG consent; confirm hotel vs office pickup." Samir replied: "Uploading now. Prefer hotel pickup but will come to 9:30 if needed."

NotaryNow-bot: Remote notary available 8am-9pm PST. Reminder: candidate must present original PR card on camera and be physically located in the US during session. Link: https://notarynow.example/schedule

Lina (Onboarding): Calendar invite created for 9:30am Mon with Hindi interpreter and NotaryNow fallback. Invite body includes checklist:
1) Upload PR card (front/back) + driver license
2) Sign background check consent
3) Complete AUP before asset handoff

IT-bot: Putting hotel shipping on hold-for label and queuing laptop. Will not provision VPN until AUP signed. If Samir picks up at front desk, IT will hand to Maya at secure desk for sign-off.

BGCheck Team: Once consent & PR card are uploaded well start ID verification. With international addresses expect 48-96h for full clear; but earliest identity match can be same day. Mark SSN pending.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks team. Ethan please confirm once docs uploaded and well finalize pickup plan. :thumbsup:
